about: The scheduler's workers: how many there are, and each one's name, model server (an OpenAI-style /v1 endpoint), model, metrics address and the lanes it takes (letters from lanes.json; empty means any lane). An empty field uses the worker section of scheduler.json. The scheduler reads this file from main; changes made from its page are committed and pushed for you. Which workers are enabled is kept on the scheduler's PC, not here.
